name: Pirate Seas
hook: Fire broadsides, sink rivals, sail off with the gold.
how: Sail between the islands grabbing floating treasure, and turn side-on to rival ships to hit them with a broadside. Sink a ship and its gold floats up for the taking; get sunk and you lose your haul, but your purse buys ship upgrades that stay with you.
controls: A/D to steer, W/S for sail, click either side of your ship or Q/E to fire; on touch, a thumb stick and tap to fire
uses: Your purse, hull, cannon and sail upgrades and best haul are saved for next time.
The biggest haul one ship carried before it sank.
The host's browser sails the bot ships, drops the treasure and decides who grabbed it first; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot captains fill the sea until enough people join.
Every ship, broadside and splash shows up for everyone at once.
Run a gold rush (more gold in every chest) without touching the code.
ideas: Add a sea monster that attacks every ship
